title: Equity-aware spatial prioritisation of distributed solar PV in Thailand: code and data
description:
Code and province-level data behind the manuscript "Equity-aware spatial prioritisation of distributed solar PV in Thailand: Policy scenarios for electricity distribution planning", submitted to The Electricity Journal.

Code is released under the MIT License. Data, figures and documents are released under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). Raw third-party inputs are not redistributed and keep their own licences (see DATA_SOURCES.md).
